_comment: Template. Copy to your project root as linking.config.json and edit. The scripts read this and contain no project-specific strings.
_wiki_dir: Folder holding your notes, relative to this file.
_private_paths: REQUIRED IF ANY NOTES ARE SENSITIVE. Relative to wiki_dir. Notes under these paths are never sent to an LLM or hosted API. They are still scored, using local vectors only.
_exclude_paths: Generated or bookkeeping files the linker, linter and tests ignore.
_required_sections: Headings your linter requires in every note. Set to {} to disable.
_frontmatter_required: Keys that must appear first, in this order, in every note.
_tag_overrides: Notes whose tag deliberately differs from its folder. Path relative to wiki_dir -> tag.
_tag_map: Folder -> expected tag. '*' matches one segment; value '$1' means 'use the matched segment'.

proposer._smart_env_dir: Optional. Obsidian Smart Connections vector store, used for topic similarity and for scoring private notes without a network call. Leave as-is if you do not use the plugin; the proposer will tell you what is missing.
proposer._mechanism_floor: Minimum raw cosine between two mechanism abstractions. Raise for fewer, stronger proposals.
proposer._exclude_globs: Boilerplate pages that carry no transferable mechanism. Matched against the path relative to wiki_dir.
proposer._max_appearances_per_note: Stops one hub note filling the whole list.
